item.title: MCHS grad is Honor Graduate in Marine class
item.description: Shayne LaCoste Jr. A Morgan City man, not yet a year out of high school, has earned a boot camp honor in the U.S. Marine Corps.

item.title: Sheriff's Office rolls out program to keep kids on right path
item.description: St. Mary Superintendent Dr. Rachael Sanders speaks Monday about the Futures Project. To her right is Sheriff Gary Driskell. The Review/Bill Decker Lt. Oscar West and Sgt. Ashleigh Wilson of the Sheriff's Office developed the Futures Project curriculum. FRANKLIN – The St. Mary Parish Sheriff’s Office, working with the parish’s School Board, has a new tool to help young people stay out of trouble.

item.title: 150 years ago, we became Morgan City
item.description: Charles Morgan Morgan City marked its 150th birthday Tuesday.

item.title: Dear Abby: Longtime companion tired of attention-seeking friend
item.description: DEAR ABBY: I’ve been with my boyfriend for 17 years. He has a friend, “Byron,” whom he hangs out with multiple times a week, sometimes up to six days.

item.title: Get It Growing: Freeze damage mimics disease symptoms in palms
item.description: LSU AgCenter photo This silver palm exhibits symptoms associated with freeze damage. For a long time in Louisiana, the biggest risk that came with growing palms was incurring freeze damage in the winter.

item.title: Jim Bradshaw: Mayeus never heard the music
item.description: Some old-timers remember when chicken wire was strung in front of bandstands in some of the Cajun dance halls. It wasn’t to keep the bands in.
